title: Create project layouts from prompted previews
body:
Add Create Layout with conversational refinement, a labeled arrangement preview, Apply, Save & Apply, and Cancel. Reuse established arrangement/apply validation and bounded one-shot provider execution.
Spec: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-16-project-layouts-design.md
Blocked by: cplsbf - Add project layout picker and Save controls
Dispatch prerequisite: the spec must be committed and available in the worker checkout. This plan only creates Backlog cards; do not start later waves early.
Done when:
- Send only bounded target-Project inventory/labels and description; disclose provider input. No terminal output, chat history, file reading, new Content, or commands.
- Strict provider proposals account for every item exactly once. Missing requested Content produces an explanation instead of process/viewer creation.
- Target ownership/revisions, Project switches/closure, cancellation, superseded replies, caps/timeouts, unavailable providers, and invalid output cannot mutate live arrangements.
- Refinement only updates preview. Save & Apply validates and persists before changing live geometry; failures preserve the candidate.
- Test new behavior first, update the feature doc, inspect screenshots of Create/refinement/errors, and verify live Sessions remain usable after Apply/Revert.
Gate: Follow AGENTS.md and the build/validation/change-control references. Run cargo check --target-dir target/agent and cargo test --target-dir target/agent, plus focused behavior tests. GUI claims require inspected screenshots; process preservation requires manager/Inspection evidence.
